description: 1D complex single-precision FFT benchmark using cuFFT (NVIDIA) or hipFFT (AMD). Performs forward complex-to-complex FFT on N samples. Reports effective GB/s based on input+output data movement.

scaling_param.name: n
scaling_param.description: Number of complex samples for the 1D FFT; should be a power of 2 for optimal performance

non_scaling_params.name: warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Number of warmup FFT executions before timing

non_scaling_params.name: iters
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed FFT executions for averaging
